title.zh: MECHREVO Linux Control · 机械革命本机硬件控制台与蓝牙水冷套件
title.en: MECHREVO Linux Control · Desktop Control Center, BLE Liquid Cooler & EC/Power Suite

summary.zh: 面向机械革命耀世系列的 Linux 硬件控制中心与全栈 Rust 系统调校套件：提供 Tauri 2 + React 暗色桌面控制台、101 键单键 RGB 与自动灯光联动、外置 LCT22002/LCT21001 蓝牙水冷 Rust 守护与防干转保护、EC 功耗/风扇调校及 NVIDIA 休眠挂起修复。
summary.en: Unified Linux control suite for Mechrevo YAOSHI laptops featuring a Tauri 2 + React dark anodized desktop center, full Rust background daemons, per-key 101-key RGB & profile automation, unpaired BLE LCT22002/LCT21001 external water-cooler control with flow protection, bounded EC/GPU power tuning, and NVIDIA hibernate fixes.

zh: Tauri 2 + React 19 / TypeScript 原生桌面控制台（mechrevo-control-gui）：支持 101 键单键矩阵编辑、三区灯光联动、性能模式/风扇曲线实时监控与 LCT22002 双区灯光/曲线可视化
全栈原生 Rust 常驻守护进程（水冷 BLE / 会话灯光策略 / 狂暴调度与 EC 安全守卫），总常驻内存约 6 MB，具备断流急停、休眠自动待机与防掉线机制
通过固定 root 助手与受 SHA-256 门禁保护的内核租约模块实现安全性能调校、只读 EC 水冷遥测与 NVIDIA DKMS 休眠修复
en: Native Tauri 2 + React 19 / TypeScript desktop studio UI (mechrevo-control-gui) covering per-key 101-key RGB matrices, lid logo glow preview, profile rules, performance tuning, and LCT22002 visualizer
Full native Rust resident daemon stack (BLE water-cooling, lighting/profile session, turbo lease & EC guard) using ~6 MB total RAM with flow-stall shutoff and logind sleep teardown
Privilege-separated root EC helper, SHA-gated turbo kernel lease module, read-only EC/WMI telemetry bridge, and DKMS NVIDIA hibernate fix
